scope: Independent read-only review of numeric-suffix #972 token-end regression source; no fixture/native/test/model execution
findings: Four three-row positive fixtures use short glossaries and a preceding exact-content match with equal numeric fields; original long-glossary/four-match admission cannot account for the required positive reuse count.
Changed key lengths and UTF8 text move the current suffix offsets; exact semantic values and attempts=1/fallbacks=0/reuses=1 catch omitted or stale numeric token ends.
Null sentinel, trailing whitespace, int32 endpoints and compact structured list cases are consistent with the composed C.

Null-to-integer mismatch must take the normal strict path with no suffix/glossary proof; negative-zero/fraction/exponent cases preserve ordinary fallback and compare complete results with reuse disabled.
Malformed later score after a successful suffix must publish no prefix; a fresh independent call must again succeed natively.

Snapshot checks decoded keys/numerics/content, canonical bytes, unique indexes and prepared lookup bytes; mandatory fused-attempt and fallback assertions prevent silent fallback from passing positives.
limitations: Static fixture/expectation review only. No type/lint, native, corpus or runtime qualification was performed by this reviewer.
Current-base source/WASM identities remain the responsibility of the separately authorized correctness acquisition.
